observations.seen: Flat, even illumination on the bike and the terrain. There is no low golden-hour key light and no visible sun direction. The orange ground reads warm, but the light itself has no modeling.
No visible contact shadow under the hovering bike in frames 1–2 or under the chase bike in frame 3. Rocks and spikes on the background track cast no readable shadows.
The bike's white and teal shell has a soft sheen but no environment reflection of the nebula sky or the orange terrain. The fairing looks diffuse, close to matte plastic.

A strong concept: a ribbon track looping through floating low-poly rocks and spikes against a nebula with a ringed planet. The foreground ground plane is a blurry, low-detail orange texture with no track markings or surface features.
Barely any depth haze between the foreground and the distant track loop. Distant elements keep full contrast, and there is no visible fog in the 30–180 m band and no dust trail.
The terrain texture is smeared and low-resolution, especially in the frame 1–2 foreground. The bike reads as a uniform glossy toy material with no metal or rubber differentiation beyond the wheel.
In frames 1–2 the bike sits off-center to the right, and the huge empty orange foreground takes up about 40% of the frame. Frame 3 has a centered chase subject but a large empty sky area.

Frames 1–2 use a side, showcase-like angle rather than a chase view. The frame 3 chase cam is reasonable, with the subject around 12–15% of the frame, slightly small. There is little speed sensation at 146 km/h.

There is mild bloom on the bike highlights and a soft overall image. There is no cinematic grade, vignette or motion blur conveying speed, and the softness looks like low resolution rather than intent.
Frames 1 and 2 are nearly identical, suggesting a stalled or static scene. The bike floats above the ground with no lean, suspension compression or contact.

A clean, consistent dark translucent panel set: position, lap, race time, standings with gaps, stardust meter and speed. The typography is legible and the layout is well organized. The center toast text is readable but slightly low-contrast over the terrain.
